abstract: Maintains rail receiving track capacities and railcar shunting schedules
system_message:
You are Rail Freight Coordinator (RFC). The Rail Freight Coordinator (RFC) oversees rail receiving track capacities and manages railcar shunting schedules across terminal facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Canada·Maintains rail receiving track capacities and railcar shunting schedules（SPUR）
information_points.content:
RFC-SPUR-5ZQ：Within its Canada operations, Great Northern Grain Transshipment Consortium logs a daily railcar unloading capacity of 120 cars over 24 hours at the receiving pit, coupled with a railcar shunting clearance lead time of 10 h.
RFC-SPUR-JO2：Regarding operations in Canada, Columbia Maritime Stevedoring Alliance maintains a daily railcar unloading capacity of 160 cars through its track hopper unloading facility over a 24-hour cycle, while its railcar shunting clearance lead time stands at 22 h.
RFC-SPUR-RFF：For operations in Canada, Pacific Northwest Bulk Cargo Logistics achieves a daily railcar unloading capacity of 160 cars over a 24-hour cycle, requiring a railcar shunting clearance lead time of 10 h.

information_points.title: United States·Maintains rail receiving track capacities and railcar shunting schedules（RAIL）
information_points.content:
RFC-RAIL-T4M：Under its United States operations, Great Northern Grain Transshipment Consortium sustains a daily railcar unloading capacity of 120 cars during a 24-hour cycle, alongside a railcar shunting clearance lead time of 10 h from interchange arrival to indexer engagement.
RFC-RAIL-NJR：In the United States, Pacific Northwest Bulk Cargo Logistics demonstrates a daily railcar unloading capacity of 160 cars sustained over a 24-hour cycle at the track hopper unloading facility, accompanied by a railcar shunting clearance lead time of 10 h.
RFC-RAIL-YLF：For United States operations, Columbia Maritime Stevedoring Alliance provides a sustained daily railcar unloading capacity of 160 cars across its 24-hour cycle at the track hopper unloading facility, with a railcar shunting clearance lead time of 10 h required to stage cars and engage indexers.
